# Bot Bastion baked-isometric sprite pack (Phase 1)

**Licence: original, generated by project scripts.** Every model is built procedurally in Blender 5.1 (headless) by
`scripts/bot_bastion_3d/bb_units.py` and `bb_sectors.py`; FX, decals and backdrops are drawn by
`scripts/bot_bastion_3d/bb_procedural.py` (Pillow + numpy). No downloaded models, textures, fonts or HDRIs.
Designs follow `docs/design/tower-defence/bot-bastion-3d/ASSET-BIBLE.md`.

Regenerate: `python scripts/bake_bot_bastion_atlas.py` (set `BLENDER` to blender.exe if it is not in the default
install path; `--skip-blender --raw DIR` re-packs existing frames). The script fails if the pack exceeds 6 MB.
`app/src/test/java/com/gamesuite/style/BotBastionAtlasManifestTest.kt` validates the result.

Files: `manifest.json` plus 8 lossy-with-alpha WebP atlases (max 2048 x 2048): `bots`, `enemies`, `enemies2`, `fx`,
`sector_cradle`, `sector_glass`, `sector_ember`, `sector_hush`.

## Conventions

- Orthographic camera, elevation 50 degrees, yaw 0, `+x` screen-right, `+y` screen-up (away from the viewer).
  Ground circles are ellipses with vertical scale `sin 50 = 0.766`. Height `z` shifts a point up by `z * cos 50`.
- `ppu` = baked pixels per arena unit (100 for units and tiles; 50 for the arena plate). Draw a frame at
  `scale = (s * zoom) / ppu` where `s` is the renderer's pixels per arena unit.
- Every frame is a trimmed rect in an atlas. `(ax, ay)` is the pixel inside the rect (origin top-left) where the
  ground-contact centre of the unit sits. Draw at `screenPos - (ax, ay) * scale`. Heads, rotors, flyers and FX can
  have an anchor outside their rect.
- Facing `k` (0..7) = heading `45 * k` degrees counter-clockwise from screen-right. If the sim's y axis points down,
  negate `dy` before `atan2`. Pick `k = round(heading / 45) mod 8`.
- Bots are layered: draw `part=base` (one frame per level), then `part=head` (8 facings per level) at the same anchor.
  Tender: `base` plus `rotor` (4 frames, 15 degrees apart, loops with period 60 degrees). Skiff and enemies are single bodies.
- Units are baked with the neutral dusk rig. Tint with a colour filter for night/alarm grades; environment frames
  (`sector` + `light` = dusk | night | alarm) are baked per light.
- 1 px ink outline `#0E1226` is baked on bots and enemies, none on terrain.
- Tiles are 100 x 77 px (1 arena unit wide, projected depth 1 unit * sin 50) and are untrimmed so they tile seamlessly.
